is_data_coverage_action.description: Optional. True marks an option that concerns obtaining or validating evidence itself (e.g. 'monitor for a source completing live validation'), as distinct from an operational preparedness action. Not required, so existing preparedness-option producers are unaffected; a returned ChatGPT assessment's zero-evidence preparedness options must set this true.

evidence_ids.description: WO-010-R4 §4. Optional, so the platform's own preparedness-option production is unaffected. A returned ChatGPT assessment's operational (non is_data_coverage_action) option must cite at least one eligible evidence_id or indicator_id here or in indicator_ids.

indicator_ids.description: WO-010-R4 §4. series_id values supporting this option, on the same optional/enforced-when-returned-by-ChatGPT basis as evidence_ids.

support_basis.description: WO-010-R4 §4. Free-text explanation of why the cited evidence_ids/indicator_ids justify this option. Explanation only -- it may never substitute for the validated support IDs themselves.

applicable_geography_ids.description: WO-010-R5 §7. Optional. Country, region or Thailand-wide geography IDs this option applies to. When set, cited support must be relevant to at least one of them; free-text applicable_to remains explanatory only, never authoritative.

applicable_lane_ids.description: WO-010-R5 §7. Optional. Lane IDs this option applies to. When set, at least one cited evidence_id or indicator_id must be one the package associates with one of these lanes.

applicable_domain_ids.description: WO-010-R5 §7. Optional. Assessment domains (e.g. 'cost_context', 'fuel_pressure', 'fx_pressure', 'operational_contingency') this option applies to, used to check that a cost/freight/fuel/FX-monitoring option cites a compatible indicator and that an operational-contingency option cites operational evidence rather than a numeric proxy alone.
